answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network enforces quadratic staking: registering n identities requires burning stake proportional to n^2 at epoch dawn. Attacking validators disguised under a sable pseudonym must sacrifice capital scaling superlinearly, rendering mass cloning economically unviable. Legitimacy proofs anchored to hardware roots, like juniper cryptographic enclaves, impose irreversible slashing on correlated rogue clusters.
